title: Conditional κ = .0038981721342 (+0.00002909569641762765% over #8052): rebuild the fixed-carrier Gaussian coupling
body:
## Result

**Conditional κ = 0.0038981721342 (+0.00002909569641762765% over #8052).** The exact predecessor is SYLforge’s [#8052](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8052) at `baaec65bf8e4c7e92be110a00d5b06522177931f`, κ = 0.003898171. The exact Δκ is 0.0000000011342 and the percentage is exactly `(5671/194908550)%`. The previous installed Gaussian cap, including the old height charge and five stopping-gap units, is smaller than the new trial by exactly `242818712673/409600000000000000000`. The current selected record is #7000.

## Construction

Replace the installed Gaussian dyadic `2092819/2^29` by `1071523491/2^38`. Rebuild the full 54-cell transport for its 105,216 productive and 564,144 paid ranks. Exactly 45 routing probabilities change. Independent directed enclosures show separation of a literal epoch allocation. The binary heights (60,000 and 960,000), Gaussian height 20,000,000, and stopping denominator 10^18 are identical to the extended predecessor. The same activation exponent 21,020,646 and all inherited geometry, tape and precision obligations apply. The complete price uses the actual 36 binary and 48 Gaussian calls. The old-price control rejects the new signed budget by the exact gap above. The inherited binary negative control rejects the old pre-k7 word at the binary price.

## Replay and scope

Use CPython 3.12 with Git.

```sh
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-gaussian-fixed-carrier
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-gaussian-fixed-carrier-installation
```

The package authenticates the archived 48-file #8052 closure by path, applies three source-local changes plus the exact generated result, and runs its eight registered modes. On exact candidate commit `e25494616bf149217644ce08d949181ea3600e13`, all eight local scientific modes passed. Both independent receipts reproduce byte for byte from a clean archive. Both registered replays returned signed product −345550037539 with 138 shuttles and 157,248 H calls. Local onboarding ran 760 tests with 31 skips and exited zero after the standard process-inspection access was enabled. The committed-byte preflight authenticated nine files and the local planner selected this package and the #7257 historical prerequisite. [Independent audit and replay receipts](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/35241f4148b1b184d5cb140ee87a60ae24e7f930/paired-768/gaussian-fixed-carrier/PROOF.md) · [Complete candidate replay](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/35241f4148b1b184d5cb140ee87a60ae24e7f930/paired-768/gaussian-fixed-carrier/candidate-replay.log) The five inherited conditional premises cover all-column native action, ownership and restoration, compiler transfer, precision and tape services, and analytic recovery. Full production-size execution and formal proof of those assumptions remain open.

## Hosted installation replay

The first hosted run passed onboarding and the historical prerequisite. Its scientific job passed binary, cost and chronology, then timed out at the 240-second installation limit. The new head `7058278aefb5744de4e3668f408a553b05722a9d` retains all eight verifier commands and their inputs. It gives full installation and receiver replay a separate bounded registered job. Local metadata and planning cover both jobs. [First hosted run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/45064057671/job/137337451947) · [Repaired head run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/45065645062)

On submitted head `7058278aefb5744de4e3668f408a553b05722a9d`, all four hosted checks passed. The main scientific job emitted all six markers including the signed product. The companion job reproduced the full fixed installation in 252.348 seconds and each of the 64,800 noncommuting receiver comparisons. [Full hosted run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/45065645062) · [Main scientific replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/45065645062/job/137342208324) · [Installation and receiver replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/45065645062/job/137342208355)
